raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Nine runtime switches that came in with #45474 still carry an internal code name (`SGLANG_Q35MF_*`, with `EDGE`, `MKH_N3B` and similar fragments). The names do not say what the switch controls and do not follow the `SGLANG_OPT_*` convention used by the other children of `SGLANG_ENABLE_NV_MEGA_RUNTIME_OPTIMIZATION`. This PR gives them descriptive names.

## Modifications

| Old name (deprecated alias) | New name | What it controls |
|---|---|---|
| `SGLANG_Q35MF_BK_VEC_COPY` | `SGLANG_OPT_SMALL_FIELD_COPY_VECTORIZED` | Vectorized small-field copy kernel |
| `SGLANG_Q35MF_MKH_N3B` | `SGLANG_OPT_SPEC_VERIFY_REUSE_STAGED_INPUTS` | Verify reuses inputs already staged on device |
| `SGLANG_Q35MF_MKH_N3C` | `SGLANG_OPT_SPEC_POST_VERIFY_ONE_LAUNCH_LOAD` | Post-verify loads its inputs in one launch |
| `SGLANG_Q35MF_EDGE_CHAIN_TREE` | `SGLANG_OPT_TRTLLM_MHA_CHAIN_VERIFY` | TRT-LLM MHA chain-shaped verify path |
| `SGLANG_Q35MF_EDGE_SPARSE_VERIFY_SAMPLING` | `SGLANG_OPT_SPEC_COMPACT_VERIFY_SAMPLING` | Compact verify sampling |
| `SGLANG_Q35MF_EDGE_PACKED_VERIFY_BCAST` | `SGLANG_OPT_SPEC_PACKED_VERIFY_BCAST` | Packed verify broadcast |
| `SGLANG_Q35MF_EDGE_SHM_SYNC` | `SGLANG_OPT_SCHEDULER_SHM_SYNC` | Scheduler shared-memory sync |
| `SGLANG_Q35MF_EDGE_SHM_SYNC_MULTIHOST` | `SGLANG_OPT_SCHEDULER_SHM_SYNC_MULTIHOST` | Scheduler shared-memory sync across hosts |
| `SGLANG_Q35MF_EDGE_MULTIHOST_TCP` | `SGLANG_OPT_SCHEDULER_SHM_SYNC_LEADER_TCP` | Leader TCP exchange for the multi-host sync |

- `environ.py`: each switch is now declared under its new name with `EnvBoolWithAlias`, keeping the old name as `deprecated_name`. Setting the old name still works and logs a `DeprecationWarning`. Defaults are unchanged and still follow `SGLANG_ENABLE_NV_MEGA_RUNTIME_OPTIMIZATION`.
- Call sites read the new names. The shared-memory exchange log and error messages drop the internal `EDGE` prefix.
- `docs/src/snippets/agentx/Qwen/*.jsx` still use the old names. They are generated from the SemiAnalysis InferenceX launch commands and are marked "do not edit by hand". They keep working through the aliases and will pick up the new names on the next sync.
- No behavior change.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no change to model outputs. Only the environment-variable names change; the old names map to the same switches.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: no change to any code path.

## Tests

- `test_environ.py`: for each of the nine switches, the old name still applies and emits a `DeprecationWarning`, and the new name wins when both are set.
- The unit tests that set these switches were updated to the new names.
- Local runs, compared with the same tests on `main`: the touched unit tests show no new failures, and pre-commit passes.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (The child switches are not listed individually in the environment-variable reference.)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Not applicable: rename only.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+    def _read(self, new, env):

+        for new, old in RENAMED_NV_MEGA_RUNTIME_CHILDREN.items():
